I couldn't do this research. My one attempt to fetch the sources was blocked by a tool limit before any pages loaded, so I've read nothing. I tried to open:

- the Enduring Word commentary on Jeremiah 48: https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/jeremiah-48/
- the Bible Hub commentary pages for vv. 1, 7, 10 and 11 (for example https://biblehub.com/commentaries/jeremiah/48-11.htm)
- a Precept Austin page for Jeremiah 48. I guessed this address and haven't checked that it exists.

You asked me to report only what the pages say and give a link for every point. Since I have no page content, writing notes on vv. 1–24 now would mean making them up from memory, so I haven't written any.

If you send your request again, I'll start from those pages. Then I'll add the NET Bible notes, Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and the other sites on your list. The verses most likely to need extra searching are:
- **v. 10:** the curse on anyone who holds back the sword
- **v. 11:** "wine on its dregs"
- **v. 7 and v. 13:** Chemosh and Bethel

You could also paste the text of any pages you already have, and I'll work from those.
